description:
Re-creating Neuro-sama, a container of souls of AI waifu / virtual characters to bring them into our worlds.


v0.15.1 Highlights
A small patch release for the iOS app, with a little polish for the desktop about window.
Product updates
Mobile
- The iOS app is now built with the iOS 27.1 SDK. v0.15.0 still used the iOS 26 SDK, so on iPhone Duo the app showed at a fixed size, with empty space around it. Full-screen display on iPhone Duo needs the new SDK. This build uses it.
Desktop app
- The about window of dev and nightly builds now keeps the build origin, such as main@f4ef800c48, on one line. The build time now uses the app language and shows as a relative time, for example "3 hours ago". Hover over it to see the full date and time.
To contributors
- iOS release builds now run on the GitHub xcode-27 runner image with Xcode 27.1. The image is a public preview, so a failed iOS build can need a rerun.
- The core-agent Spark command tests now import from source, so they also pass in a fresh checkout that has no build output.
